text.zh: 这份 2025 年物种记述汇总了 2001—2022 年采集项目中的野外记录。作者报告十个地点（原文地点编号 3—12），分布在克罗地亚中部的上切蒂纳盆地和波黑西北部南部的 Livansko Polje；记录的环境包括泉、切蒂纳河与间隙生境。它们是论文列出的采集点，不能据此画出完整分布边界。
text.en: The 2025 species account summarizes field records from a collecting program spanning 2001–2022. It reports ten localities (numbered 3–12 in the paper) in Croatia’s upper Cetina Basin and southern Livansko Polje in north-west Bosnia and Herzegovina. The reported settings include springs, the Cetina River and interstitial habitats. These are the sites listed in the paper, not a complete range boundary.

text.zh: 模式产地是指定模式标本采集的地点。本文记载的模式产地为克罗地亚 Cviljane 的 Kotluša 泉，坐标 43°56′57″N、16°23′56″E，海拔 397 m。正模 NHMW-MO-113902 于 2017 年 3 月 17 日采集。这个地点提供的是该标本的定位，不代表本种全部分布。
text.en: A type locality is the place where the designated name-bearing specimen was collected. The paper gives the type locality as Kotluša spring at Cviljane, Croatia (43°56′57″N, 16°23′56″E; 397 m). The holotype, NHMW-MO-113902, was collected on 17 March 2017. This locates that specimen; it does not represent the species’ full distribution.

text.zh: 研究把该种的线粒体操作分类单元记为 mOTU D，并报告 COI 序列登录号 PX113150—PX113167。作者指出，COI 数据不能解析更深层的系统发育关系，因此 mOTU D 是这项研究中的序列分组标签，不能读成完整的物种树位置。
text.en: The study assigns the taxon to mitochondrial operational unit mOTU D and reports COI sequence accessions PX113150–PX113167. The authors caution that COI data do not resolve deeper phylogenetic relationships. Here, mOTU D is the study’s sequence-group label, not a placement in a complete species tree.

text.zh: 该处理将本种评为易危（VU D2）。这是论文作者提出的评估；本地证据没有确认它对应一条当前有效的 IUCN 或国家红色名录记录。作者评估的范围也受论文所列地点资料限制，不能直接当作独立核实的现行正式等级。
text.en: The treatment assesses the species as Vulnerable (VU D2). This is the authors’ assessment; the local evidence does not identify an independently verified, current IUCN or national Red List entry. Its scope is also limited by the locality information reported in the paper, so it should not be read as a separately verified current formal status.

readerSummary: COL26.8 lists *Radomaniola testavariabilis* Grego, Beran & Falniowski, 2025 as a species in Hydrobiidae; the exact COL identifier was joined to the archived MolluscaBase record by ID, not by a name-only match. That nomenclatural match does not establish full biological-concept equivalence. The 2025 treatment describes the shell and soft-part anatomy and gives a diagnostic account. Its type locality—the collection place of the holotype—is Vrelo Vrioštica spring, Vitina, Ljubuški, Bosnia and Herzegovina (43°14′15″N, 17°29′09″E; 93 m). The holotype NHMW-MO-113904 was collected 2018-04-02. The treatment lists six localities, its numbers 15–20: three in Croatia and three in Bosnia and Herzegovina, including springs, the Neretva River, and interstitial water. The study groups the sampled mitochondrial COI sequences (accessions PX113128–PX113141) in operational unit mOTU A; the authors caution that COI does not resolve deeper relationships, and this grouping is not a species-tree placement. The authors assess the species as Vulnerable (V), but that is not a verified current IUCN or national Red List listing.
readerSummaryZh: COL26.8 将 *Radomaniola testavariabilis* Grego, Beran & Falniowski, 2025 列为 Hydrobiidae 科的物种；其分类编号通过精确编号与存档的 MolluscaBase 记录对应，而非仅凭名称匹配。这一命名对应关系不能证明生物学物种概念完全相同。2025 年分类处理描述了贝壳及软体部分的解剖特征，并给出鉴别记录。正模产地（正模采集地点）为波黑 Ljubuški 的 Vitina、Vrelo Vrioštica 泉（43°14′15″N, 17°29′09″E；海拔 93 m）。正模 NHMW-MO-113904 于 2018-04-02 采集。该处理列出六个地点（编号 15–20）：克罗地亚三个、波黑三个，生境记录包括泉、内雷特瓦河和间隙水。研究将样本的线粒体 COI 序列（登录号 PX113128–PX113141）归入操作单元 mOTU A；作者指出 COI 数据不能解析较深层的系统发育关系，因此这里不把该分组当作物种树上的位置。作者在该处理中的评估为易危（V），但这不是经核实的当前 IUCN 或国家红色名录等级。

title.en: What does the species description cover?
title.zh: 分类描述涵盖哪些内容？

text.en: The 2025 species treatment describes the shell and soft-part anatomy of *Radomaniola mislinensis* and provides a diagnosis. This dossier records the scope of that account but does not extract a full character matrix; measurements, sex and developmental-stage coverage, and variation among specimens have not been independently summarized. The observations concern the treatment specimens, not a complete account of variation across the species.
text.zh: 2025 年的种级处理描述了 *Radomaniola mislinensis* 的贝壳与软体部解剖，并给出诊断。本档案记录该条目的范围，但没有提取完整的性状矩阵；测量值、性别和发育阶段的覆盖情况、标本间变异均未作独立整理。这里的观察限于处理研究所用标本，并非对全种变异的完整说明。

title.en: Two reported springs bound the locality record
title.zh: 两个已报道泉点限定了地点记录

text.en: The treatment gives Mislina spring, in the Neretva River Delta near Metković, Croatia (42°58′56″N, 17°36′24″E; 4 m), as the type locality; holotype NHMW-MO-113906 was collected on 2020-08-04. It also reports spring Studena (locality 13). The authors describe the known area as very small and around the spring that supplies Mislina lake. This account covers only named collection localities and does not identify unsampled sites or establish a complete range.
text.zh: 该处理将克罗地亚内雷特瓦河三角洲、Metković 附近的 Mislina 泉（42°58′56″N, 17°36′24″E；海拔 4 m）列为模式产地；正模 NHMW-MO-113906 于 2020-08-04 采集。文中还报告了 Studena 泉（地点 13）。作者称已知区域很小，位于为 Mislina 湖供水的泉周边。本条目只覆盖文中列出的采集地点；没有确认未采样地点，也不能据此建立完整分布范围。

title.en: What the mitochondrial evidence can resolve
title.zh: 线粒体证据能够解析什么

text.en: The 2025 study assigns the taxon to mitochondrial operational unit mOTU B and reports COI accessions PX113142–PX113146 for the sampled wild snails. The authors caution that COI data do not resolve deeper phylogenetic relationships; mOTU B is not a species-tree placement.
text.zh: 2025 年的研究将该分类单元归入线粒体操作单元 mOTU B，并报告所取样野外蜗牛的 COI 登录号 PX113142–PX113146。作者指出，COI 数据不能解析较深层的系统发育关系；mOTU B 不是物种树上的位置。

text.en: The authors of the 2025 treatment assess the species as Endangered (EN), within the locality scope reported in that account. This is their assessment only, not a verified current IUCN or national listing; assessment criteria, date validity, and population trend were not independently checked.

text.en: The 2025 taxonomic treatment includes a species-level description of the shell and soft-part anatomy, as well as a diagnosis. The source does not list the diagnostic characters, so no specific shell or anatomical difference can be described.
text.zh: 2025 年的分类研究提供了该物种的贝壳与软体部分解剖描述，也给出了鉴别诊断。来源没有列出具体诊断性状，因此无法描述哪些贝壳或解剖差异可将这种蜗牛与近缘种区分开来。

text.en: The treatment describes a wild freshwater snail. It names Spring Vrutak at Kostanje-Kučiće, in Croatia’s lower Cetina Canyon, as the type locality. The holotype—the name-bearing specimen—is ZMUJ2024/04, collected on 31 August 2018.
text.zh: 研究将其描述为一种野生淡水蜗牛，并把克罗地亚下契蒂纳峡谷 Kostanje-Kučiće 的 Vrutak 泉列为模式产地。正模标本（作为物种命名依据的标本）编号为 ZMUJ2024/04，采集于 2018 年 8 月 31 日。

text.en: The same treatment reports the snail from four springs in the lower Cetina Canyon. These are localities documented in that account, not a survey of the species’ full geographic range.
text.zh: 同一研究记录了下契蒂纳峡谷中的四处泉水地点。这些是该篇研究记载的局部地点，并不代表对该物种完整分布范围的调查。

text.en: The study assigns the snail to mitochondrial operational unit mOTU C and reports COI marker sequence accessions MZ539646, MZ539647, PX113147–PX113148. The paper cautions that these COI data do not resolve deeper evolutionary relationships; the mOTU label is not a species-tree placement.
text.zh: 研究将这种蜗牛归入线粒体操作单元 mOTU C，并报告了 COI 标记序列登录号 MZ539646、MZ539647、PX113147–PX113148。论文指出，这些 COI 数据无法厘清更深层的演化关系；mOTU 标签也不等于物种树上的系统发育位置。

text.en: The authors assess the species as Vulnerable (V), citing local water, tourism and construction pressures. This is the treatment’s assessment; it has not been independently verified here as a current formal listing.
text.zh: 作者将该物种评估为易危（V），并提到当地的水相关压力、旅游和建设压力。这是该分类研究中的评估；此处未能独立核实它是否属于当前正式名录中的等级。
